goal: Keep Superpowers enabled as an on-demand method layer while making Harness the explicit authority for task classification, verification, topology and closure.
userValue: Agents gain reusable planning, debugging and verification methods without reintroducing the worktree, approval and duplicate-verification friction that Harness v0.6 removed.
nonGoals: No backend, API, PG read-model, mini-program, deployment or production-data behavior changes.
No dependency installation, third-party download, new lane registry or resource-lease system.
No removal of Harness candidate deployment, scoped live smoke, evidence promotion or explicit closure safeguards.

engineeringHealth.reason: The change narrows local workflow orchestration only and adds a manifest contract test; it leaves runtime release behavior untouched.

decisionLog.decision: User approved keeping Superpowers enabled with Harness as the sole project-level control plane and an explicit method-layer precedence rule.
